criteria.question: Are controller-only outcome sealing and mutually exclusive Packet-v2 or explicit nonreporting disposition admitted and regression tested without authority promotion?

A create-only reporting reservation binds request, dependency plan, parent head, untrusted clock observation, the exact planned final Packet or nonreporting artifact, and the closed nonreporting reason (null for Packet), so competing or semantically mismatched branches cannot finalize.
